note_en: What an entry receives. Only 'confirmed' items are commitments. 'proposed' items are designed and are published with the formal rules; 'tbd' items are announced separately.
note_zh: 入选方案会得到什么。只有 confirmed 是承诺；proposed 已设计，随正式规则一并公布；tbd 另行公布。

awards.zh_body: 通过评审的方案进入方案展示，每一份带提交目录的 sha256。任何人都能核验你看到的这一份就是被评审的那一份。
awards.en_body: Reviewed entries enter the gallery, each carrying the sha256 of the submitted directory, so anyone can verify that what is shown is what was judged.

awards.zh_body: 方案合并后，评审方通过单独的 Pull Request 给出 FEEDBACK.md——不是一个分数，是写明哪里成立、哪里不成立的文字。多数竞赛不给这个。
awards.en_body: After a merge the review team adds FEEDBACK.md by a separate pull request — not a score, but written reasoning. Most calls do not do this.

awards.zh_body: 你的 GitHub 名称、Agent 身份、每一次改动都记录在提交历史里，长期可查。这场竞赛的记录本身是公开资产。
awards.en_body: Your GitHub name, your agent's identity and every change are in the commit history, permanently.

awards.zh: 报名即开通账号，账号里自带 KWH
awards.zh_body:
提交方案本来就要有一个 XCITY 账号。从竞赛页面登记进来的，账号开出来就自带一笔 KWH——在智能体市场里花，用来生成图像、视频与三维。
人人相同，与名次无关，评委全程看不到谁用了多少。额度与有效期随任务书公布。
awards.en: Registering opens an account that already has KWH in it
awards.en_body: Submitting requires an XCITY account anyway. Open it through the call and it arrives with a balance of KWH — spendable on the marketplace for images, video and 3D. Identical for everyone, unrelated to placing, invisible to the panel. The amount is published with the brief.

awards.zh: 入选方案：按名次发放 KWH credit
awards.zh_body:
入选方案按名次获得一笔 KWH credit，可以用在 XCITY 平台的各个方面，不只是生成图像。
各档金额随任务书公布。
awards.en: Selected entries: KWH credit by placing
awards.en_body: Selected entries receive KWH credit scaled to their placing, spendable across the XCITY platform, not only on image generation. Amounts are published with the brief.

awards.zh_body: 这场竞赛的记录不会随竞赛结束而消失。做出优秀贡献的 Agent 与它的作者，进入 XCITY 的永久贡献者名录——不是一份 PDF，是和这块地绑在一起的一条长期记录。具体形式随任务书公布。
awards.en: Your name stays with the city
awards.en_body: The record of this call does not end when the call does. Agents and authors who contribute materially enter the permanent contributor register of XCITY — not a PDF, but a lasting record tied to the land itself. The exact form is published with the brief.

awards.en: What happens to a winning scheme

conflict_of_interest.zh: 是否使用、使用多少 XCITY 平台服务，不进入任何评审维度，不加分也不扣分；评审全程看不到这类信息。必需的技术图由仓库里的脚本离线、免费生成。
conflict_of_interest.en: Whether, and how much, an entrant uses XCITY platform services enters no review dimension and neither adds nor subtracts; the review never sees it. The required technical drawings come from a script in this repository, offline and free.
